hooks.name: DEVLOG Updater
hooks.description: After any source file is saved, prompts Kiro to append a new session entry to DEVLOG.md reflecting the change — keeping architecture, API, migration, and component tables in sync.

action.prompt:
A source file was just saved. Read DEVLOG.md first, then determine whether the change warrants a DEVLOG update.

Update DEVLOG.md if the saved file affects any of the following:
- A new or modified API endpoint (update the API Endpoints table)
- A new or modified database migration (update the Database Schema table)
- A new or modified AI agent, tool, or pipeline step (update the watsonx Orchestrate Agents table or AI Agent Architecture section)
- A new or modified backend controller, service, route, or middleware
- A new or modified frontend page or component
- A new environment variable (update the Environment Variables table)
- A bug fix that resolves a Known Issues / Gaps entry (mark it ✅ Done)

If the change warrants an update, append a new entry under "## Development Session Log" using the format of the existing session entries. Include: what changed, why, and any remaining TODOs. Do NOT create a new top-level section — append to the existing session log only.

If the change is trivial (formatting, comments, whitespace only), do nothing.
